summary: Master corporate governance for SOEs with practical tools for boards, ownership, risk, and reporting. Enrol to strengthen oversight and accountability.
lede: State-owned enterprise governance training helps board, ownership, and control professionals strengthen oversight and turn findings into practical actions. It develops skills in governance gap analysis, board effectiveness, performance dashboards, risk registers, and disclosure planning. Exercises help participants map ownership roles, build diagnostic scorecards, and prepare board improvement plans and reporting tools.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals working inside state-owned enterprises, ownership entities, and control functions who need practical governance tools rather than abstract theory. It is especially useful if you prepare board papers, monitor performance, review controls, or support reform programmes in an SOE context. SOE board members responsible for strategic oversight and fiduciary challenge. Company secretaries managing board packs, minutes, and committee records. Ownership-entity officials monitoring state shareholder objectives and performance. Governance managers coordinating board evaluation and policy compliance. Internal auditors reviewing controls, assurance, and escalation processes. Chief financial officers overseeing budgets, capital, and fiscal discipline. Risk managers maintaining enterprise risk registers and escalation thresholds. Legal counsel advising on duties, conflicts, and disclosure obligations. Performance management specialists tracking KPIs and board dashboards. Public sector reform advisors supporting governance and ownership reform.
outcomes: Financial Oversight And Budget Variance Analysis
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises and be prepared to work with sample board packs, governance checklists, and spreadsheet-based templates. If possible, bring a current SOE governance document, ownership report, or performance dashboard from your organisation for use in the exercises.
